Overflow Advisory Level:

MSD-01 Wet Weather Overflows.

MSD-01 Wet Weather Overflows.


Recent rainfall has created the risk of sewer overflows in the Louisville Metro area. Avoid contact with water in the Ohio River, streams, drainage ditches and standing water until 48 hours after the rain has stopped. For more information, call MSD Customer Relations at 502-540-6000.
